title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Cherry Burst 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Cherry Burst Nic Salt e-liquid delivers the irresistible taste of ripe, juicy Cherries bursting with sweetness in every puff. This smooth, fruity e-liquid captures the vibrant and rich flavour of fresh-picked cherries, offering a bold and satisfying vape experience for fruit lovers. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are perfect for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Offering a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine relief, this e-liquid is ideal for those seeking a fruity alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths, Cherry Burst provides a flavour-packed vape that’s as refreshing as it is satisfying. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK vape brand renowned for their vibrant and original e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range brings intense, disposable vape-inspired flavours to a more versatile format for use with reusable vape devices. Discover other delicious flavours from this collection, such as Pineapple Ice, Berry Frenzy, and Blue Sour Razz.
